verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions guest access, external access, shared channels, or limited-access permissions for outside partners. The Graph docs on creating teams, adding people and configuring channels say nothing about external users, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit. External collaboration is a fair axis for a team-chat product, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can collaborate with external partners through guest accounts or shared channels with limited access
